item.title: Adani Airport to Raise $1 Billion From Temasek, BlackRock Among Others
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: Indian billionaire Gautam Adani’s airport unit is raising 98.25 billion rupees ($1 billion) through a stake sale to a consortium of global investors that includes Alpha Wave, Temasek, Premji Invest and BlackRock Inc.-managed funds. The sale of a 5.54% stake in Adani Airport Holdings Ltd. values the company at a pre-money equity valuation of $18 billion, according to a company statement Wednesday.
